code_proven: nativePowerPlayPoints reconciles original final landing scoring with boxscore goals/assists/PP goals and score including shootout adjustment; yields PP goals plus PP assists.
Its output is private_historical_observed_counts conditioned on positive_minute_historical_appearance.
gaps: This is observed outcome derivation, not an as-of predictor or proof that all official-appearance cases are supported.
findings.adjustment: Reuse reconciled counting rules only after v2 identity/receipt/appearance adaptation; avoid confusing PP goals with PPP or this historical result with pregame input.
